item.title: Good Morning Family - 01 August 2026
item.description:
Good morning Walkers!
Hello everyone!
Today is Saturday, the 1 August.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be mostly sunny, with a low of 2 degrees and a top of 13 degrees.
There is about a 0 percent chance of rain.
You might need a warm jumper today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is E.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter E?
. . . . . . . . . . . . .
